hypothesis: W-R53 ridge sometimes improves weak source-family performance but uses training exposure to every tested generator. A source-blind ridge learner trained only on TWO of the three synthetic generator families may or may not discriminate original versus swapped pairs from the entirely withheld third family. This qualifies extrapolation rather than known-source interpolation.
freeze: Three new disjoint dev blocks5200..5215,5232..5247,5264..5279, untouched sealed heldout5312..5359 (48 seeds), 3 fixed leave-one-generator-out arms per dev block (9 fixed models). Development for two included source families uses seed-parity-balanced entity choices yielding exactly864 signed examples per included family, 1728/model. Fixed same 4-bit lag2 XOR-invariant 16 features, ridge normal eq λ1.0 only, both original-first and original-second paired scoring, identity and XOR55 conditions, three generators/two swap sites. No training, tuning or selecting based on withheld generator or sealed results; the withheld generator is never sampled for that arm's training.
criteria: UNSEEN_SOURCE_GENERALIZATION iff for EVERY development block at least two of the three withheld-source accuracies are >=0.55 AND no withheld source has <0.48; PARTIAL_UNSEEN_SIGNAL iff for at least one same withheld source ALL THREE independently trained models score >=0.53; NO_GAIN otherwise. Report each unseen score, full training-generator controls, across-cohort variability and all adverse findings without selecting favorable source after result.
controls: No training source heldout generator-specific examples within that arm, source identities only used to construct fixed training split and measure score in evaluator, never an inference feature.
Each source arm 864+864 signed paired examples with seed-parity entity choice predeclared, 16 coefficients and deterministic solver residual gate.
Single new sealed cohort shared by nine models; three dev models per withheld generator do not constitute independent physical source-birth; all output retained.
Original first-use evidence, final one Go regression/build, no accepted ref or independent FSA approval, no FORGE R26 seed use, no production/controller authority changes.
claim_limit: Synthetic unseen-generator family transfer under two-choice paired ranking, not source-origin independent replication or general cognitive intelligence.
